data.source: Freddie Mac Single-Family Loan-Level Dataset Sample 2015

endpoint.primary: first monthly Current Loan Delinquency Status >= 03 before zero-balance termination
endpoint.competing: any first zero-balance termination, preserving original code
endpoint.same_month_rule: zero-balance termination is competing; event ordering within month is unknown

time.entry: completed months from First Payment Date to first observed performance interval

model.bootstrap_scope: test-loan resampling with fitted models and preprocessing held fixed
